Name: Maggie AST Complete
Description: Complete Astrologian event profile based on Jasper's verified healing structure. Opener stays enabled and Save CD is never changed automatically. General healing, emergency recovery, mitigation, raises and cleanses complement fight-specific Timeline Reactions. Manual ally targeting temporarily pauses offensive target ownership so emergency heals and manual raises take priority.
